title: Asymptotics of Multi-Scale McKean--Vlasov Diffusions with Super-Linear Kernels: a Lifted Semigroup Approach
summary: In this work, we establish the small-noise asymptotic behaviour (namely, the functional law of large numbers and the large deviation principle) for multi-scale McKean--Vlasov diffusions with super-linear kernels. In this setting, the interaction depends on the laws of both the slow component and the fast oscillating process. Consequently, the frozen (parameterized) system exhibits McKean--Vlasov dynamics, forming a nonlinear Markov process and thereby rendering the analysis more complex compared to existing works.
